author: reactive-end
summary: Orchestrator can now stage/commit/push/branch and read or open PRs with gh (git apply/am and program-launching flags stay refused); `--help` works for every role; executor write-path detection ignores PowerShell parameter values, npx package installs and unexpanded variables and follows literal cd; gitignored edits are not tracked; Stop no longer demands closing the task while an executor runs; hook help lists user-prompt-submit.
